relations.subject: Karma Phuntsho
relations.evidence: In 1986, he moved to Thimphu and had a short spell at Yangchenphug Higher Secondary School before leaving to become a monk and study Buddhism at Chagri Monastery.

relations.subject: Karma Phuntsho
relations.evidence: Later, he went to south India to continue his studies, spending a year at Sera Monastery then ten years at the Ngagyur Nyingma Institute.

relations.subject: Karma Phuntsho
relations.evidence: Since 1994, he has taught Buddhism and related subjects and has served a lecturer at the Ngagyur Nyingma Institute in Bylakuppe.

relations.subject: Karma Phuntsho
relations.evidence: In 1997, partly he says because young Bhutanese educated in English looked down on monks even though they were very learned, he joined Balliol College Oxford and read for an M.St.
